proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemComponentMechanics.spawned_creature
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is a magic-item activation that creates, controls, and dismisses a summoned companion. The surface has spawned-creature support only for spells, not for magic items.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to summon a Fire Elemental

proposed_widenings.name: item_proximity_activation_gate
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation is gated by being near the item itself, not by holding/wearing it. Existing EquipmentPredicate variants cannot express 'within 5 feet of this brazier'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier

proposed_widenings.name: item_origin_spawn_placement
proposed_widenings.justification: The summoned creature's placement is anchored to the item's location rather than the caster's range origin. Existing spawned-creature spell range semantics are caster-originated.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. The blocker is structural: magic items cannot currently use the spawned_creature family. A secondary surface gap remains even after that: proximity-to-item activation and item-anchored spawn placement.
